layout: row = terrain type, column = variant * frames + frame
mask: pixel (x, y) belongs to the tile if |x + 0.5 - 32| / 32 + |y + 0.5 - 16| / 16 < 1; tiles at offsets (32, 16) fit without gaps or overlaps
blend_note: row = edge of the screen diamond (ne = between top and right corner), column = variant; white, alpha 0 or 255. Draw the tile of a neighbour with higher priority (wasser < erde < fels < waldboden < gras < wiese) over the tile, cut by the mask of the shared edge
